payload.name: Compress Image to 50KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup 50KB image compressor with an optional one-contact USD 9 upload fix-plan request.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based image compressor for strict 50KB upload limits, passport-style photos, forms, and application portals. It works without an account or server upload and now exposes a one-contact optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request for exact public-safe settings, fallback steps, and a review-before-upload checklist after fit is confirmed.
